title: PEMO Problem.type registry
decidedBy: ADR-009, amended by API-016-ST; surface applicability confirmed by ADR-007 D2
why: Problem.type was declared as string / uri-reference with no enum and no registry, so a typo was undetectable by every check this project runs. `session-expried` validated, passed the fixture validator, passed the contract suite, and would have silently broken every client branching on the field — which is the field's entire purpose. A discriminator that is not validated is not a discriminator. It is a string.
location: This file sits ABOVE the per-surface packages deliberately. ADR-007 D2 decides separate contract packages with shared vocabulary and confirms one registry with per-surface applicability. A registry inside resident-mobile/ would force any second surface either to reach into a sibling package or to keep its own copy, and a second copy is the two-spellings-of-one-concept outcome ADR-009 exists to prevent.

howToUse.normative: This file is the source of truth. The Problem.type enum in each surface's openapi.yaml is GENERATED from it, filtered by `surfaces`, and the validator asserts the two agree. Do not author a type URI in a schema.
howToUse.forward: Every type URI a fixture carries, and every type URI the running service emits, must appear here. This is the assertion that catches the typo.
howToUse.reverse: Every entry with status `active` must be reachable: it appears in at least one fixture, or it names `emittedOnlyBy`. An entry meeting neither fails. A declared type nobody emits is a client branch that can never be taken.
howToUse.containment: A fixture on a given surface may only carry a type whose `surfaces` includes that surface.

addingAType.steadyState: The emitting session proposes the URI, its httpStatus, surfaces and client guidance. The contract track adds it here with `since` set to the version being released. A new type is a new value a client must accept, so it is a MINOR bump under ADR-008.
addingAType.interim: A session emitting before it can edit this file carries a local assertion that its emitted type URIs equal an explicit expected set, and the contract track folds it in at the next contract change. A local carry is a debt with a named creditor: it is recorded in the register against the contract track, and the next contract change folds it in.
addingAType.supersedes: This registry supersedes GEN-013-ST's session-local assertion in tests/contract/error-surface.test.ts, which was the interim stand-in for exactly this. That assertion is forward-only and constrains one session's emissions; this file is both directions and constrains the contract. It should be retired by its owning session — two sources of truth for one set is the condition this registry exists to remove.
addingAType.sharedMeaning: A type applies to more than one surface ONLY when the meaning is identical — session expiry, an invalid credential and an internal error mean the same thing to a resident and to staff. Where the meaning differs the surfaces get different URIs even if the shape matches: management scope failure is `insufficient-scope`, NOT the resident `not-authorized`, because the resident one is unit-scoped and the management one is a grant over hierarchy nodes and Locations. Two surfaces meaning different things by one discriminator is the defect this registry exists to prevent.

bad-request.summary: The request was malformed or failed validation at the edge.
bad-request.clientGuidance: A client fault, not a resident-visible condition. Do not surface the detail; the body carries no driver or SQL text by design.
bad-request.note: Emitted undeclared from 0.1.0 — shipped by GEN-006-ST, found by GEN-013-ST reviewing its own prior work (G5). Declared for the first time in 0.3.0, fixtured for the first time in 0.3.1 by API-020-ST. G5 IS ONLY HALF CLOSED: of the four operations named here, only acknowledgeSafetyEvent declares a 400 response, so the other three still emit a status their contract does not declare. Closing that is a surface change and a minor bump.

caregiver-scope-expired.summary: A caregiver's authorization to view this home has ended.
caregiver-scope-expired.clientGuidance: Distinct from not-authorized: the relationship existed and lapsed. Tell the caregiver when it ended and who can renew it.

communications-unavailable.summary: The communications port is unconfigured. This is not a successful send.
communications-unavailable.clientGuidance: Render an explicit unavailable state. Do not treat this as a log-only or accepted send. Retry after communications are configured.
communications-unavailable.note: Declared in management-web 2.7.0. Invoice-email, notice email, and notice delivery map an unconfigured port to 503 rather than 500.

cursor-expired.summary: A paging cursor is no longer in this result set (deleted, stale, or unknown).
cursor-expired.clientGuidance: Restart the walk from the first page. Never treat this as an empty last page.
cursor-expired.note: Added by Batch B Round 3 (P2-3). An unknown after previously sliced as a silent empty last page and dropped rows.

duplicate-acknowledgement.summary: A different acknowledgement already exists for this resident and event.
duplicate-acknowledgement.clientGuidance: Not an error to retry. The resident has already acknowledged; say so rather than asking again.

estate-not-found.summary: No such estate, or its existence must not be disclosed to this principal.
estate-not-found.clientGuidance: Produced by the in-query scope filter, which is this operation's authoritative gate: an estate outside every grant the principal holds returns no row and is indistinguishable from one that does not exist. A distinct refusal would confirm the estate, which is why addEstateContact declares no 403.
estate-not-found.note: Added by GEN-014, the third scope-only write.

event-not-found.summary: No such safety event, or its existence must not be disclosed to this resident.
event-not-found.clientGuidance: Deliberately indistinguishable from another household's event. Confirming existence would disclose a safety event in another home.

event-retracted.summary: The event was retracted or corrected by its source.
event-retracted.clientGuidance: Follow supersededBy to the replacement. A correction stays linked to its original.

grant-already-exists.summary: A live grant already confers this role at this node to this group.
grant-already-exists.clientGuidance: A DOMAIN refusal, not a scope one. Two DIFFERENT groups holding the same role at one node is legal (ADR-012 D5) and is not this case: the conflict is per (group, role, node).
grant-already-exists.note: Added by GEN-027. The cardinality guard moved from a constraint to the write path at GEN-024.

grant-not-live.summary: This grant is not live -- already revoked, or lapsed by its own dating.
grant-not-live.clientGuidance: Nothing is appended. A failed precondition must not leave a no-op assertion in the version chain.

grant-target-not-found.summary: No such node or grant, or its existence must not be disclosed to this principal.
grant-target-not-found.clientGuidance: G-2 (ADR-010 D3) admits a grant act only within a node the caller already holds as `grant_administrator`. A caller with no such grant receives this, indistinguishable from a node that does not exist -- which is why these operations declare no 403: a distinct refusal would confirm the target exists to someone with no authority over it.
grant-target-not-found.note: Added by GEN-027, the first surface that creates authority.

idempotency-key-conflict.summary: This idempotency key was already used for a different request.
idempotency-key-conflict.clientGuidance: ADR-015 D5. The key is never silently answered with the earlier act's result -- that would report something that did not happen. Use a new key, or repeat the original request exactly.
idempotency-key-conflict.note: Added by GEN-027. Detected on the request fingerprint, because the act id is derived from (operation, key) and is therefore identical for both.

identity-already-recorded.summary: This external identity is already recorded in this organization.
identity-already-recorded.clientGuidance: Recorded once per organization (ADR-016 D3). The same person in a DIFFERENT organization is a separate principal and is not this case.
identity-already-recorded.note: Added by GEN-033. The derived-key stance means an identical retry replays rather than reaching this.

insufficient-administration-scope.summary: The caller does not administer every node the group confers authority at.
insufficient-administration-scope.clientGuidance: ADR-017's delegation floor: membership is conferral by proxy, so the floor is G-2 lifted to the SET of nodes the group holds live grants at -- a conjunction, never a subset. A group with no live grants requires grant_administrator at the ORGANIZATION node, which closes the pre-staging path. A 403 rather than a 404 here, deliberately: the group's existence is not a secret to a caller who administers the organization at all, and telling them WHICH authority they lack is what lets them obtain it.

insufficient-scope.summary: The requested target lies outside every scope grant this principal holds.
insufficient-scope.clientGuidance: NOT the resident `not-authorized`, which is unit-scoped and narrower. This is scope-grant failure over the ADR-002 hierarchy or an ADR-003 Location, and reusing the resident URI would make two surfaces mean different things by one discriminator.
insufficient-scope.note: Added by API-017-ST; fixtured in tests/fixtures/management-web.

integration-unavailable.summary: An upstream integration this projection depends on is unavailable.
integration-unavailable.clientGuidance: Render an explicit unavailable state. NEVER fall back to a normal or all-clear presentation — missing data must not render as normal.

internal-error.clientGuidance: Render an explicit error state. The same never-render-as-normal rule applies to a failed request as to stale data.

invalid-credential.summary: The credential is absent, malformed or not a credential this service issued.
invalid-credential.clientGuidance: NOT recoverable by refresh — this is the distinction from session-expired, which is. Re-authenticate from the start.
invalid-credential.note: Added by GEN-013-ST under B5, which separated four causes previously collapsed into one 401. Fixtured in 0.3.1 by API-020-ST, provoked by an absent token. G7 REMAINS OPEN AND IS NOT THIS FIXTURE'S CONCERN: the five session-expired fixtures were provoked by an ABSENT token, which under B5 is this type. Three possibilities differ in severity — the fixture's type is wrong, the backend emits session-expired for an absent token, or the provocation record is stale. GEN-013-ST landed B1's TTL and B5's types together so the honest provocation became possible; whether the five were RE-PROVOKED after the TTL landed is the backend track's to answer.

invalid-request.summary: The request could not be read or a query parameter is not valid.
invalid-request.clientGuidance: Correct the request and retry. The detail names the field and the problem and never echoes the rejected value.
invalid-request.note: Declared in Batch B Round 3. staffProblems.badRequest already emitted this URI; malformed page limits now map to it instead of 500.

last-grant-administrator.summary: This is the last live grant administrator in the organization.
last-grant-administrator.clientGuidance: Refused because the state is unrecoverable: with no live grant_administrator anywhere in the organization, no grant can be conferred again, and provisioning cannot re-enter because the organization has already held grants. Revoke a different administrator, or confer another first.
last-grant-administrator.note: Added by GEN-027. Refusing to remove the last way in is not a break-glass -- it opens no path to self-granting.

management-office-contact-exists.summary: This estate already has a management office contact.
management-office-contact-exists.clientGuidance: A DOMAIN refusal, per contact kind: emergency and approved-service contacts are legitimately plural, so the rule is not blanket uniqueness. Reachable only in scope.

membership-already-exists.summary: This person already holds a current membership of this group.
membership-already-exists.clientGuidance: A DOMAIN refusal. Re-adding after a removal is legitimate and is NOT this case -- that creates a new membership instance.

membership-not-live.clientGuidance: Nothing is appended: a failed precondition must not leave a no-op assertion in the version chain.

not-authorized.summary: Authenticated, but not authorized for the requested unit.
not-authorized.clientGuidance: Used where the resident's own lack of access is safe to state. Where confirming existence would leak another household's data, event-not-found is used instead.

occupancy-already-exists.summary: This resident already holds a current occupancy of this unit.
occupancy-already-exists.clientGuidance: A DOMAIN refusal, not a scope one, and reachable only in scope: the conflict lookup is scope-filtered, so an out-of-scope caller receives the 404 and never learns an occupancy exists.
occupancy-already-exists.note: Added by GEN-013. Distinct from the 404 because the act is refused for a reason the caller can act on.

occupancy-not-live.summary: The occupancy is not live — already ended, or lapsed by its own dating.
occupancy-not-live.clientGuidance: A precondition refusal, and nothing is appended: a failed precondition must not leave a no-op row in the assertion chain. NOT a retry response — repeating an end answers this, not the original 200, because retry-idempotency is the request-token half of ADR-013 D6 and is not built.
occupancy-not-live.note: Added by GEN-016, the occupancy end write.

occupancy-target-not-found.summary: No such unit or resident, or its existence must not be disclosed to this principal.
occupancy-target-not-found.clientGuidance: Deliberately indistinguishable from a unit outside every grant this principal holds, and from a resident of another Organization. A distinct refusal would confirm the target exists to someone with no scope over it, which is why recordOccupancy declares no 403. A management-specific URI rather than the resident `event-not-found`: the registry's sharedMeaning rule forbids two surfaces meaning different things by one discriminator.
occupancy-target-not-found.note: Added by GEN-013, the second scope-only write (ADR-010 D1).

organization-already-provisioned.summary: This organization has held a grant before and can never be provisioned again.
organization-already-provisioned.clientGuidance: The predicate is ZERO GRANTS EVER, not zero live grants. Under a liveness predicate an organization that revoked its last grant would become provisionable again by anyone -- the standing break-glass ADR-010 A1 forbids, reached through an ordinary revocation.

principal-target-not-found.summary: No such group, person or membership, or its existence must not be disclosed.
principal-target-not-found.clientGuidance: Deliberately indistinguishable from a target in another Organization: cross-organization isolation is absolute (ADR-007) and is not a role.

record-not-found.summary: No such record, or its existence must not be disclosed to this principal.
record-not-found.clientGuidance: One URI across resource kinds, with `instance` identifying the record — RFC 9457's own shape. Deliberately NOT the resident `event-not-found`, whose meaning is narrower: that one hides another household's safety event, this one hides another tenant's record of any kind.
record-not-found.note: Added by API-017-ST; fixtured in tests/fixtures/management-web.

restricted-projection.summary: The requested projection is integration-support material and is not available to the estate-staff tier.
restricted-projection.clientGuidance: ADR-007 D3 tier boundary. The export already draws the denied view and a `Request access` path; that path is a write and is deferred. Raw payloads and correlation traces are not in this contract at all — absent, not gated.
restricted-projection.note: Added by API-017-ST; fixtured in tests/fixtures/management-web.

scope-not-found.summary: No such scope node or Location, or its existence must not be disclosed to this principal.
scope-not-found.clientGuidance: Deliberately indistinguishable from a node in another Organization. Confirming existence would leak another tenant's structure.
scope-not-found.note: Added by API-017-ST; fixtured in tests/fixtures/management-web.

session-expired.summary: A previously valid session has passed its expiry.
session-expired.clientGuidance: Recoverable by re-authenticating. Distinct from invalid-credential, which is not.

unmapped-unit.summary: The unit is not mapped to a monitored location, so no safety status can be resolved. This is the quarantine path.
unmapped-unit.clientGuidance: Tell the resident plainly that status cannot be shown. NEVER say everything is normal. Guessing the nearest unit would send one household's safety alert to another.

notice-not-found.summary: No such notice, or none this caller may act on.
notice-not-found.note: ALSO the answer when the caller holds no authority over the notice, deliberately: a distinct 403 would confirm the notice exists to someone with no scope over it. Same decision as the grant surface (ADR-010 D3).

notice-out-of-scope.summary: The caller does not hold a live grant covering EVERY node the notice addresses.
notice-out-of-scope.note: ADR-017 D1 lifted to notices: covering some addressed nodes is not partial authority to address some of them, because there is no partial notice. Returned as 404 for the reason above.

notice-wrong-state.summary: The transition is not legal from the notice current state.
notice-wrong-state.note: A domain refusal, never a fault (ADR-013 C4): the caller asked for something reasonable about a notice that has moved on.

notice-stale-version.summary: The act names a version that is no longer current.
notice-stale-version.note: The derived-key stance (ADR-015 D1): a repeat naming the CURRENT version is a retry and replays; one naming a superseded version is a caller acting on a notice that changed under them. Applying it to the new state would be them approving text they never read.

notice-approval-required.summary: This notice type is gated and the notice has not been approved.
notice-approval-required.note: FAIL-CLOSED: a type with no approval-policy row is GATED, because a missing row is "nobody has decided" and the safe reading of an undecided question about broadcasting to residents is that a second person looks.

notice-incomplete-translation.summary: A draft may be half-written; a publication may not.
notice-incomplete-translation.note: Publishing English-only silently decides that Chinese readers get nothing.

notice-empty-audience.summary: The targeting rule resolves to nobody.
notice-empty-audience.note: FAIL-CLOSED: far likelier a mistargeted notice than a deliberate broadcast to an empty building, and publishing it would record that residents were told something when none were.

notice-schedule-inverted.note: A schedule that ends before it starts is not a schedule.

notice-retargeting-forbidden.summary: A correction may change content and schedule only.
notice-retargeting-forbidden.note: The audience snapshot records who WAS addressed; a correction that retargeted would leave it describing an audience the notice no longer has. Retarget by withdrawing and issuing a new one.

notice-not-addressed.summary: This resident is not in the audience snapshot for the published notice.
notice-not-addressed.note: Membership is the SNAPSHOT taken at publication, never a re-resolution of where the resident lives today: those differ the moment somebody moves, and re-resolving would let a resident who arrived afterwards acknowledge a notice they were never sent.

notice-not-this-resident.summary: The authenticated principal is not the resident named.
notice-not-this-resident.note: Acting as oneself. A staff member recording an acknowledgement on a resident behalf is a different act with a different floor and a different forgery risk, and it is deliberately absent.

notice-not-yet-visible.summary: The notice is published but its publish_at is still in the future.

notice-no-question-asked.summary: This notice declares no response options.
notice-no-question-asked.note: No declared question means there is no answer to record, not that any answer will do.

notice-undeclared-option.summary: The chosen key is not one of the notice declared options.
notice-undeclared-option.note: Responses are a controlled vocabulary per notice; free text waits on ADR-019 OQ4 (retention), because prose is what a retention rule is actually about.

ticket-invalid-transition.summary: The requested ticket status does not follow from its current one.
ticket-invalid-transition.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

ticket-message-visibility-fixed.summary: A message's visibility is set at write and cannot be changed; a resident-authored message is always resident-visible.
ticket-message-visibility-fixed.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

ticket-anonymous-no-conversation.summary: An anonymous ticket accepts no resident message and no resident-visible reply.
ticket-anonymous-no-conversation.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

ticket-not-the-reporter.summary: Only the ticket's reporter may perform this act as a resident.
ticket-not-the-reporter.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

ticket-reopen-not-permitted.summary: Residents may not reopen tickets in this organization, or the reopen window has closed.
ticket-reopen-not-permitted.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

ticket-not-closed.summary: The act needs a closed ticket.
ticket-not-closed.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

satisfaction-already-recorded.summary: Satisfaction was already recorded for this closure.
satisfaction-already-recorded.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

case-invalid-transition.summary: The requested case state does not follow from its current one.
case-invalid-transition.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

case-owner-cannot-see-case.summary: The proposed owner holds no grant covering the case's node.
case-owner-cannot-see-case.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

case-external-link-required.summary: awaiting_external needs a recorded external link.
case-external-link-required.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

case-not-closable.summary: A case closes only from pending_verification or resolved, by a person.
case-not-closable.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

case-note-visibility-refused.summary: Case notes are always internal; a visibility field is refused.
case-note-visibility-refused.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.

no-such-case.summary: The case does not exist in this organization.
no-such-case.clientGuidance: Declared on the internal act contract (GEN-055); a route surfaces it when C4 lands, at which point its surface is widened and its fixture is recorded over HTTP.
